draft_frames.purpose: 为目标视频提供全局一致性锚点
draft_frames.prompt: Pure person reference image. A single Western (Caucasian) adult woman, age impression 20-30, athletic and confident dancer, medium-length natural hair (loose or tied back), natural light sport makeup, slim athletic build, wearing a bright-colored (e.g. coral or teal) athletic crop top with dark high-waisted sports shorts or leggings, clean white sneakers, no glasses, no hat. Standing full body, facing camera, neutral relaxed pose, plain seamless light-gray studio background, soft even daylight, photorealistic, sharp focus, full body visible head to toe. No text, no logo, no watermark, no brand marks, no other people.
must_include: 亮色运动上衣+深色运动短/紧身裤

draft_frames.purpose: 为目标视频提供全局一致性锚点
draft_frames.prompt: Pure scene reference image, no people. An empty outdoor public basketball court in daylight: hard asphalt or acrylic court surface with white painted court lines, a basketball hoop with backboard and metal pole in the midground/background, chain-link fence or open court-side area behind, green trees or low buildings in the far background, overcast soft natural daylight, cool low-saturation color, medium depth, realistic documentary photography, vertical composition. No people, no text, no logo, no watermark, no brand marks.
must_include: 硬质地面+白色球场画线

revisions: person 与 scene 各一张，覆盖全部全局人物/场景实体；无重复实体无需合并
